verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 5 does not close the round-4 boundary. `usage-alert.py` still changes the operator guidance emitted by `render()` and the route-contract comment in `main()`, while guard 1 pins only `_alert_route`'s docstring and the dispatch workflow comment. The module-wide census remains an explicitly finite lexical tripwire, so appending an unlisted assertion such as `ALERT_TOKEN has issue-creation privileges at ALERT_REPO` to either changed block leaves both exact-equality pins untouched and is outside `phrasings`; the self-test remains green. The prior major finding therefore persists at the same severity, so progress is stagnant.
